description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


See the assets below to download this version and install.
What's Changed
- feat(sqlite): add sqlite database creation workflows by @Jishnu-Prasad888 in #523
- Fix connection modal height by @DhruvShah-Dev in #538
- Fix PostgreSQL key metadata for readonly users by @DhruvShah-Dev in #543
- fix(ai): add MiniMax regional endpoint metadata by @octo-patch in #498
- chore(ci): pin third-party GitHub Actions to commit SHA by @jeffersongoncalves in #540
- feat(er-diagram): export the schema as Mermaid or DBML by @gcapellib in #521
- fix(er-diagram): prevent node overlap and add node lock toggle by @debba in #558
- fix(notebook): harden SQL generation for params and cell references by @debba in #559
- fix(data-grid): open dedicated editor for array cells on double-click by @Davydhh in #489
- feat(indexes): render functional/expression indexes across drivers by @Davydhh in #499
- feat(editor): label the Run button with what it will actually run by @ymadd in #532
- fix(mcp): parse preflight explain output in the approval modal by @debba in #567
- Fix sidebar accordion action spacing by @DhruvShah-Dev in #539
- Fix DML submit schema selection by @DhruvShah-Dev in #542
- Register DynamoDB plugin by @fuleinist in #574
- feat(connections): forward raw connection URIs to plugin drivers by @Robbyfuu in #495
- feat(data-grid): navigate cells with the arrow keys by @ymadd in #552
- feat(editor): allow reordering tabs via drag-and-drop by @maximumbreak in #517
- fix(mysql): include MariaDB SYSTEM VERSIONED tables in table list by @gustavomelo-dotgroup in #568
- feat(datagrid): Select All rows via Cmd/Ctrl+A and context menu by @iamthenuggetman in #549
- feat(users): database user & privilege management (MySQL/MariaDB) by @pokertour in #478
- Connection modal UX: SSH tunnel test, classified errors, stoppable test with diagnostics by @debba in #570
- All-databases mode: empty selection loads every database automatically by @debba in #572
- Fix PostgreSQL visual query identifier quoting by @DhruvShah-Dev in #553
- build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 4.4.0 to 7.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in #554
- build(deps): bump KSXGitHub/github-actions-deploy-aur from 4.1.2 to 4.2.0 by @dependabot[bot] in #555
- build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6.5.0 to 7.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in #556
- build(deps): bump pnpm/action-setup from 5.0.0 to 6.0.9 by @dependabot[bot] in #557
- fix(nightly): scope the prerelease counter to the version base by @debba in #585
- feat(postgres): support editing hstore columns by @arturbent0 in #427
- chore(plugins): bump DynamoDB plugin to v0.1.3 by @fuleinist in #589
- Feat/bundle jetbrains mono extrabold by @GabrielMalava in #547
